Eligibility check for 1200 units within 30 days from one supplier:
- Alpha: max 1700 >= 1200 qualifies, 18 days <= 30 qualifies
- Bravo: max 1000 < 1200 fails quantity, 10 days qualifies -> ineligible
- Cobalt: max 2400 >= 1200 qualifies, 35 days > 30 fails deadline -> ineligible

Only Alpha qualifies.

Alpha cost:
Goods = 1200 * 11.91 EUR = 14292 EUR
Goods in USD = 14292 * 1.08 = 15435.36 USD
Goods + shipping = 15435.36 + 600.00 = 16035.36 USD
Duty = 8% * 16035.36 = 1282.8288 USD
Total landed = 16035.36 + 1282.8288 = 17318.1888 USD = $17,318.19

Bravo and Cobalt are ineligible despite lower hypothetical totals, so cannot be ranked.
